questions.question: Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F and G - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of B. Only three people sit between G and B. D sits second to the right of A. D is not an immediate neighbour of B. E sits to the immediate right of F. Who among the following sits at the extreme left end of the line?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F and G - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) Only two people sit to the left of B.

2) Only three people sit between G and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/692ba5f7f043ecf978155eaed23c88f6641c3f349b53abe3731b79a515ace57d.png] 

3) D sits second to the right of A.

4) D is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb677e0bbff69b3ea7170deae5d79af7e6e61d442d6545158ac57ff02e071954.png] 

5) E sits to the immediate right of F.

After positioning E and F only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac54aeebd9aa742a92a3acebb872eb33dc4327135f16295fc9bdaba6e615e35.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F sits at the extreme left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All potatoes are vegetables

All carrots are vegetables. 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some carrots are potatoes.

II. All vegetables are carrots.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15eac2b08e6a440882179c4aa5bf2ae3698ef4f1b5577514cf3df5d8285c63f6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some carrots are potatoes → Does not follow (As all potatoes are vegetables and all carrots are vegetables. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All vegetables are carrots → Does not follow (As all carrots are vegetables. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number × 9 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 15 : 135

⇒ 15 × 9 = 135.

For, 24 : 216

⇒ 24 × 9 = 216.

Similarly, for 13 ∶ ?

**⇒ 13 × 9 = 117.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
